newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary Christian Democrats ousted from EUCD - radio.
newsitem.headline: Hungary Christian Democrats ousted from EUCD - radio.

text.p: The Hungarian Christian Democrat (KDNP) party has been ousted from the European Union of Christian Democrats (EUCD), a party official told Hungarian radio on Monday.

Party official Laszlo Surjan said the reason for the KDNP's exclusion was that the party had failed to fulfil undertakings to end internal divisions, sever all ties with Hungary's extreme right and seek cooperation with centre-right parties.

The KDNP has been plagued by internal strife since last summer and the party, led by right-leaning president Gyorgy Giczy, recently ousted some centrist members who have since formed a splinter group within the party.
The KDNP has 23 seats in the 386-seat Hungarian parliament where a coalition between Socialists and the liberal Free Democrats has 72 percent of the seats.
